description: Reverse text in one of three ways. 'characters' reverses the entire text character by character. 'words' reverses the order of words on each line. 'each' keeps the word order but reverses the letters within each word. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/reverse-text/

mode.description: 'characters' (default), 'words' reverses word order per line, 'each' reverses letters within each word
